budget_items.topic: FY tax rate and tax bills
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Interim Town Manager reported the final tax rate was set and bills expected next week, pending Department of Revenue sign-off on free cash.
budget_items.quote: the final tax rate was set at $14.36 and he and anticipates tax bills will be mailed out next week.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town is still awaiting Department of Revenue sign-off on free cash; no amount was stated.
budget_items.quote: still waiting on department of revenue to sign off on free cash.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: About $105,000 in ARPA funds remained at the end of the prior week, with reallocation pending final roof contractor estimates.
budget_items.quote: they had roughly $105,000 in arpa funds remaining.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Interim Town Manager was awaiting a final roof contractor estimate for the Ritter Building before reallocating remaining ARPA funds; no figure was stated.
budget_items.quote: he stated he is awaiting final roof contractor estimates for the ritter building before reallocating the remaining funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Final documents were delivered to process a payment to the Village at Flat Hills; no amount was stated.
budget_items.quote: he also met with the village at flat hills representative to identify the final documents they need to submit to process the payment.
